mapper.select: SELECT id, creator_id, assignee_id, title, description, location, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, creator_id, assignee_id, title, description, location, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} order by created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, creator_id, assignee_id, title, description, location, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} order by created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, creator_id, assignee_id, title, description, location, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket
order by created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket ( creator_id, assignee_id, title, description, location, category, priority, status ) VALUES ( #{creatorId}, #{assigneeId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{status} )
